title: Latency Trellis: model/route IO-mode cohort & playback dashboard
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a single interactive dashboard (the 'Latency Trellis') that lets SREs and runtime engineers slice latency by model family, route, and IO-mode (streaming vs non-streaming) for p50/p95/p99, with an integrated cohort playback panel that replays representative requests to reproduce tail behaviour. This ticket covers the dashboard layout, new metric rollups, sampling hooks for traces, and default alert SLI thresholds. Goal: reduce time-to-root-cause for tail latency regressions and make rollout impact visible to PMs/Platform engineers.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 for selected model families and routes with a streaming vs non-streaming toggle
Cohort selector supports date range + request-shape filters (tokens, conversation length, presence of tools) and returns a top-100 candidate set
Playback panel can re-run sampled requests against a canary model variant and surface side-by-side latency and error diffs
Trace links included for requests in tail cohorts with at least 1% adaptive trace sampling + targeted tail-sampling for p95+ requests
Metric rollup job updates (1m granularity) emitted to metrics pipeline and visible in dashboard with <30s lag
Default alerts created for route-level p95 regressions (>20% relative increase over baseline) and p99 absolute thresholds per model family
tasks: Design dashboard wireframe (Console UX) and get design approval (DES-420)
Add metric tags: model_family, route, io_mode, request_shape to metric exporter
Implement metric rollup job in metrics pipeline (1m buckets) and add streaming/non-streaming facet
Add trace sampling hook: base 1% sampling + 100% for requests flagged as p99 candidate within last 5 minutes
Backend: cohort selector API and playback runner with canary routing support
Frontend: Trellis grid, cohort playback UI, trace modal, and alert configuration panel
Create playbook snippet and runbook links for oncall
QA: synthetic tests for cohort extraction and playback correctness
